recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast theatrical composition featuring a central human hand making an 'L' shape, integrated with large-scale geometric typography against a backdrop of draped green velvet curtains and a floor-level spotlight.
coreVisualRelationships: The hand gesture serves as a literal replacement for the letter 'L' within the primary wordmark.
The vibrant green curtains provide a high-saturation background for the stark white typography.
A gold horizontal header bar anchors the top of the frame, providing a secondary level of information.
The floor spotlight creates a circular glow that grounds the hand and provides a base for the bottom text.
coreInvariants: Vibrant emerald green curtain backdrop with visible folds.
Large, white, geometric sans-serif lowercase typography.
Integration of a human hand into the letterforms.
Gold horizontal bar at the top with black inset lines.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A human hand is centered vertically, scaled to occupy the middle third of the frame, acting as a bridge between the left and right halves of the main text.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white lowercase 'g' and 'ee' characters flanking the hand.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top gold bar, drops to the large white wordmark, follows the vertical line of the index finger, and ends at the bottom spotlight text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight composition with minimal negative space; the curtains fill all areas not occupied by text or the hand.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Emerald green (background curtains) providing depth and texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white (primary typography) for maximum legibility and pop.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold (top banner) and warm skin tones (hand) to break the green/white dominance.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the greens; high value contrast between the white text and dark curtain shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Horizontal crossbars in 'e' are perfectly straight.
Tight kerning with some character overlap.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'l' is replaced by a photographic human hand making an 'L' shape (thumb out, index finger up).
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and scales for consistency.
graphicDevices: Horizontal gold banner with black rules

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and lowercase 'g' structure.
Provides the necessary geometric weight and clean lines.
Modern alternative with similar x-height and circularity.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a theatrical stage background with deep emerald green velvet curtains featuring heavy vertical folds. Include a bright white circular spotlight hitting the floor in the bottom center. Add a horizontal gold metallic banner at the very top with two thin black lines running through its length. Place a realistic human hand in the center making an 'L' gesture (thumb extended right, index finger pointing up).
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a bold geometric sans-serif like ITC Avant Garde, typeset the main word in lowercase white. Position the 'g' to the left of the hand and 'ee' to the right, so the hand's index finger acts as the 'l'. Add secondary lowercase white text in the top center, bottom right, and bottom center spotlight area.

verificationChecks: Is the hand gesture clearly forming the letter 'L'?
Are the curtains a vibrant, saturated green?
Is the main text in a bold, geometric, lowercase sans-serif?
Does the gold banner at the top contain black horizontal rules?

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of the hand and text

postGenerationChecks: Check that the 'g' and 'ee' are perfectly aligned horizontally.
Ensure the gold banner is perfectly horizontal and spans the full width.
Verify the spotlight glow does not wash out the bottom text.
Confirm the hand looks natural and not digitally distorted.
recipe.reuseFormula: Theatrical Backdrop + Geometric Typography + Integrated Hand Gesture + Metallic Header Bar = Show-themed Graphic Identity.
